provenance: Synthetic throughout. Traces come from a physiological model calibrated to published GLAM summary statistics (937 pregnancies, Dexcom G6, Diabetes Care 2024): mean glucose 98 +/- 7 mg/dL, median time 63-120 mg/dL 86%, postprandial peak 126 +/- 22 mg/dL. Calibrating to published statistics rather than to GLAM's records means no value shown here is traceable to any human subject.

foods.name: Plain bagel
foods.note: Refined wheat, very little fiber, so it empties fast.

foods.name: Whole-wheat bagel
foods.note: Same bagel, more intact bran. Slower to break down.

foods.name: Steel-cut oats
foods.note: Coarser cut than instant, so it digests more slowly.

foods.name: Instant oatmeal
foods.note: Pre-cooked and milled fine, which speeds absorption.

foods.name: Sourdough
foods.note: Fermentation lowers the rate of release a little.

foods.name: Seeded rye
foods.note: Dense crumb and whole seeds, so it releases gradually.

foods.name: Corn tortillas
foods.note: Masa, nixtamalised, with more intact structure than flour.

foods.name: Brown rice
foods.note: Bran layer left on. Same amount of carbohydrate, slower.

foods.name: White rice, cooked and cooled
foods.note: Cooling forms resistant starch, which behaves more like fiber.

foods.name: Whole-wheat pasta, al dente
foods.note: Cooked firm rather than soft, which slows breakdown.

foods.name: Roasted potato wedges, skin on
foods.note: Skin on and left in pieces rather than mashed.

foods.name: Orange juice
foods.note: The fiber has been removed, so it arrives quickly.

foods.name: Whole orange
foods.note: Same fruit with its fiber still attached.

foods.name: Plain Greek yogurt
foods.note: Strained, so more protein and much less sugar.

foods.name: Unpasteurised queso fresco
foods.blocked_reason: Listeria risk. Soft cheeses made from unpasteurised milk, including queso fresco, are a recognised source.

foods.name: Black beans
foods.note: Protein and fiber together, and it counts toward the day's carbohydrate.

foods.name: Baked salmon
foods.note: Low mercury, and a good source of DHA in pregnancy.

foods.name: Swordfish
foods.blocked_reason: FDA and EPA advise avoiding shark, swordfish, king mackerel, tilefish and bigeye tuna in pregnancy because of methylmercury and fetal neurodevelopment.

foods.name: Cold deli turkey
foods.blocked_reason: Listeria risk unless heated until steaming.

foods.name: Liver pate
foods.blocked_reason: Teratogenic at high intake. Liver and liver products are the main dietary source.

foods.name: Glass of wine
foods.blocked_reason: No established safe amount in pregnancy.

additions.title: Add two eggs alongside it
additions.detail: Protein next to the carbohydrate flattens the rise without taking anything off the plate.

additions.title: Add cottage cheese on the side
additions.detail: About 14 g of protein. The meal stays exactly as it is.

additions.title: Add half an avocado
additions.detail: Fat slows stomach emptying, so the same carbohydrate arrives more gradually.

additions.title: A handful of almonds with it
additions.detail: Protein, fat and fiber in one. Easy to keep in a bag.

additions.title: Start with a green salad
additions.detail: Vegetables first, then the rest of the meal as planned.

additions.title: Add roasted vegetables
additions.detail: More volume and more fiber alongside the same main course.

additions.title: Add black beans
additions.detail: Protein and fiber together, and they count toward the carbohydrate pregnancy needs.

additions.title: Add a portion of salmon
additions.detail: Protein plus DHA, which matters in the third trimester.
